xlg09_cfb_opener_served_loso_logloss.description: College-only opener-error rule (point-in-time college fit before each NFL season) added with an intercept to the logit of the served out-of-season home probability as an offset, leave-one-season-out on 2020-2025 at the true Tuesday opener, against an intercept-only control on the same offset. Held-out log loss gain, game-level bootstrap. Fold coefficient on the rule is negative in all six folds (-0.295 to -0.616). Fit made to freeze the forward term xlg09_cfb_opener_served; 3 metric looks in this family.
xlg09_cfb_opener_served_loso_logloss.notes: Reliability is the split-half value recorded for the college-to-NFL transfer predictor class (13-season pool), reused, not re-measured. Bootstrap is over games, not season blocks.
xlg09_cfb_opener_served_loso_logloss.plain_summary: We checked whether a pattern in college football opening lines says anything about which side covers the NFL's Tuesday line once the card's own probability is already known. Over the last six seasons the NFL leaned slightly against the college pattern and the gain from using it is too small to tell apart from nothing, so no pick changes; it is being logged on future games instead.
